reviews.name: mark smith
reviews.text: OMGOSH, Juan & his crew were ABSOLUTELY AMAZING! We honestly wish we had before-and-after pictures because the difference was incredible. This was around June 2026, and we were in a really stressful situation with A LOT of stuff spread throughout a multigenerational house and property. Juan and his crew were quick, professional, respectful, and worked extremely hard from the moment they arrived. They never complained—not once. They just rolled up their sleeves, worked together, and got the mission accomplished. We were in a very tight spot and needed everything handled quickly, and they came through exactly when we needed them. Their teamwork, attitude, and work ethic were outstanding. They made an extremely stressful situation so much easier for us, and we are truly grateful for everything they did. If you need a crew that works hard, gets the job done, and treats you with respect, I HIGHLY recommend Juan and his crew! 5 stars doesn't feel like enough! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.name: Felipe W
reviews.text: Amazing Amazing service by Heavy Haulers & Junk Removal. Juan and his crew were very professional and accommodating. Recently moved into a home that needed lots of TLC with tree and shrub care. We bit off way more than we could chew and ended up with a mountain of tree brush we could never bag up. Other companies couldn't make it that day and were very expensive. Juan gave a great quote and came within a few hours. So thankful for this company and the work they did. Highly recommend. A+++++

reviews.name: dwayne richie
reviews.text: This company was beyond amazing by thoroughly removing all the items  from my back yard. Juan the CO owner came by before and after the job to provide quality assurance checks and make sure that we were satisfied with the work completed. Everything was removed and yard cleaned before we returned home. The price estimate was exact and fair as we agreed. We highly roccomend the services of Heavy Haulers.

reviews.name: Jordan Sithong
reviews.text: I panicked this morning when I realized I had put all this cardboard out front of our house from recently moving in and didn't realize bulk trash doesn't come until next week! I immediately reached out to a few places. Heavy Haulers immediately came out within an hour and had everything broken down and removed from the property in a whole hour!! They were the best, I would recommend them to all family and friends and will be using them again in the future!!

reviews.name: Lisa Coe
reviews.text: My husband and I have been doing some work around the house and as teachers, we work during holidays. We had plans to get rid of a pile of old decking during our spring break. Well, my husband had a heart attack and is on bed rest for 6 months. I was trying to figure out how I could manage this on my own because I did not want to wait any longer to be rid of this wood pile and have our driveway back. I looked into renting trucks, trailers and even large dumpsters. Feeling overwhelmed, I looked for companies online that hauled off construction debris and noticed Heavy Haulers had some great Google reviews. They lived up to all of these reviews and more. I love the fact that I did not have to leave a message because they picked up on my call right away. I sent pictures of the pile and quickly received a quote, that was very reasonable, and a crew was out just a few hours later. What would have taken me at least a half days work just to load the debris and then a drive to the landfill to unload it, took them 30 minutes. I nearly cried when I walked out to say thank you and pay them for their service. They were kind and I was grateful. Thank you Heavy Haulers!!

reviews.name: Steve Jones
reviews.text: Extremely satisfied with the removal of a heavy sleeper sofa and side chair.  The gentlemen took extra care to get the sofa through the doorway and were a pleasure to work with.  Excellent pricing.  Same day pick up.  Will use Heavy Haulers and Junk Removal again in the future if needed.

reviews.name: Samuel Sobrino
reviews.text: Heavy Haulers was outstanding! They came same day and cleared out my rental property within an hour. Amazing service, professional, and great value.

reviews.name: Wayne Smith
reviews.text: Exceeded my expectations. Showed up when promised; Employees were professional; The area where items removed from was clean after job was completed and absolutely no issues with condition of property after job was completed; Price was very reasonable. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Miranda Lowe
reviews.text: Juan and his team were absolutely amazing. Very quick response and same day service. These guys are amazing and will definitely be using them for the near future!

reviews.name: Carrie Fernandez
reviews.text: We needed a fast pickup of a ton of junk, and Juan and his guys came the same day and did a very thorough job! We'll be using them again.

reviews.name: Alice Conte
reviews.text: They did an amazing job of removing my hot tub from an enclosed screened porch. There were several unexpected issues and they handled them very professionally.

reviews.name: Samantha McAdams
reviews.text: Heavy Haulers are the absolute best! They were hauling our debris off site within 24 hrs of calling them. We had a big project and they took care of everything in one day. So easy to work with and very responsive to all my calls and texts. Excellent pricing! Very competitive rates for top notch service. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Jaiden Williamson
reviews.text: Heavy Haulers did an awesome job with us! They were super friendly and very quick and convenient for us. My sister and I needed our garage cleared out and they came by and took out old furniture and trash in the span of 10 minutes. They did great!

reviews.name: David Jasper
reviews.text: 2 guys removed a hot tub for me in under an hour. Made it look easy! Thank you!

reviews.name: Joana Gomes
reviews.text: These guys are awesome. Very professional, punctual and prices are very reasonable. You will not be disappointed with them. I highly recommend you  Heavy Haulers and will definitely work with them in the near future .
